card.title: Samsung Galaxy A32 5G Not Turning On Diagnose

source.title: Samsung Galaxy A32 5G Not Turning On Diagnose

claims.statement: Galaxy A32 5G DCPS patterns: full short on plugging the boot cable = VBAT short (often charging IC); 0.050–0.070 A before pressing power with no response = VPH_PWR short; 0.100–0.200 A stuck after power = CPU running but not reaching UFS (cold joints, ripped pads, dead UFS); 0 A before and after = not triggering (power key line, power IC or crystal).
With the charger in, VPH_PWR should be stable 3.0–4.2 V; diode value near the charging IC should be 0.250+.

1.8 V on SYSTEM_RESET_B means the power IC section is OK; 1.8 V on WATCHDOG means the CPU is powered and talking; a MediaTek USB port in Device Manager suggests CPU/UFS joint faults or a dead UFS (test with EasyJTAG, Medusa, JCID U15 etc.).

procedure: Watch DCPS draw on boot cable and power press.
Check charging IC: VBUS in, VPH_PWR out and stable.
Check power IC buck coils and shorts.
Check for MTK port; reball CPU/UFS or test UFS.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
